integrity: The theorem uses source-cited exact run-onset and legal-factor results and separately proves the sharp bounds for all other factors. Computational evidence is explicitly distinguished from the infinite induction.
scientific_limitations: Only contiguous factors of the specified binary infinite word; no full arrival ordering or other alphabets. The finite checker validates bases, not the general induction. Priority remains subject to inaccessible or unindexed equivalences.
title: Sharp factor-completion thresholds for Brik's infinite binary word
